verification_instructions: 1. Run php -l on all PHP files to check syntax. 2. Verify Blade templates have valid syntax by checking for unmatched directives.
setup_instructions: No setup required - this is a standalone Rhymix module with Blade templates.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No Rhymix runtime available for integration testing. Validation is limited to PHP lint and template structure checks.
contribution_requirements: Templates must use v2 Blade (.blade.php) syntax. Variables accessed as $var (auto-converted to $__Context->var). Use {{ }} for escaped output, {!! !!} for raw. Admin templates should follow the x_nav x_nav-tabs pattern from Rhymix core board module.
key_patterns: Admin templates use <div class='x_page-header'><h1> + <ul class='x_nav x_nav-tabs'>. Attendance module uses @include('_header') pattern for shared admin header. User skins use setTemplatePath + setTemplateFile in controller. Context::set() passes variables to templates. $lang->key for i18n. BanRecord::formatDuration() for duration display. BanRecord::isAppealWindowOpen() for appeal window check.
directory_structure: conf/ - module metadata. controllers/ - MVC controllers. models/ - data models. views/admin/ - admin Blade templates. skins/default/ - PC user skin (EMPTY, needs implementation). m.skins/default/ - mobile user skin (EMPTY, needs implementation). queries/ - XML DB queries. schemas/ - DB table definitions. lang/ - language packs.
